sloka: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः ।समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षते परन्तपौ ।। ५.३८.४८।।।।
transliteration: mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ ।samarthāvapi tau yanmāṁ nāvekṣate parantapau ।। 5.38.48।।।।

translations.english: "Perhaps I must have committed an atrocious sin. There is no doubt. For although both of them are scorchers of enemies, they deliver me not."
